top_buys.pitch: Fed hike bets and a 10-year yield near 5% are a direct hit to housing affordability.
top_buys.why: The dollar is near a 19-month high purely on expectations the Fed may hike again, and commentary notes the 10-year approaching 5%. Mortgage rates track that yield, so builder traffic, incentives and margins get squeezed. Homebuilder shares tend to grind lower as higher rates feed through rather than repricing in a single day.
top_buys.risks: A soft inflation print or dovish Fed speaker could knock yields down and spark a sharp rebound in rate-sensitive housing names.
top_buys.watch: The 10-year Treasury yield and upcoming Fed speakers' comments on the energy-shock inflation debate.

top_buys.pitch: Extending the Jones Act waiver erodes the regulatory moat around US domestic shipping.
top_buys.why: Reuters reports the White House is set to extend its Jones Act shipping waiver, which lets foreign-flag vessels carry cargo that normally must move on US-built, US-crewed ships. Matson's economics depend on that protected status in Pacific trades. Policy news like this is usually under-covered and takes time to show up in rate expectations.
top_buys.risks: The waiver may be narrow in scope or not touch Matson's routes at all, making the impact largely symbolic.
top_buys.watch: The formal scope and duration of the waiver when published.

top_buys.pitch: Deal spread widening on an FTC 'last rites' meeting signals real antitrust risk to the Cintas takeover.
top_buys.why: A 'last rites' meeting is typically the final step before the FTC decides to sue, and the merger spread widened on the report. The same agency is reportedly preparing to block the Covetrus-MWI deal, suggesting an aggressive posture. If the FTC sues, UniFirst falls back toward its standalone value.
top_buys.risks: Antitrust meetings often end without a suit, and a clean approval would snap the stock back up to the deal price.
top_buys.watch: Any FTC complaint filing or company statement on deal timing.

top_buys.pitch: A 19-month-high dollar and rate-hike bets are classic headwinds for gold.
top_buys.why: The dollar is at a 19-month high on Fed hike expectations and the yen is testing 160, while silver opened down over 3%. Higher real yields raise the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding metal. Precious metals usually drift lower for a while once a hawkish repricing takes hold.
top_buys.risks: Escalation around Iran and Hormuz could spark safe-haven buying that overrides the dollar effect.
top_buys.watch: The dollar index and the next US inflation print.

top_buys.pitch: FTC plans to sue to block the $3.5B Covetrus-MWI deal, removing an expected divestiture.
top_buys.why: Cencora agreed to sell its MWI Animal Health unit, and a blocked deal means no cash proceeds and a longer strategic limbo. Antitrust headlines usually weigh modestly on the seller for several sessions. The size is small relative to Cencora, so this is a mild, not dramatic, drag.
top_buys.risks: Cencora's core drug distribution business is strong and could easily swamp this minor setback.
top_buys.watch: Confirmation of an FTC complaint and any Cencora commentary on alternatives.
